# Model comparison

| Model | Recall@10 overall | NDCG@10 overall | Recall@10 cross-category | NDCG@10 cross-category |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| ALS | 0.6700 | 0.3247 | 0.6301 | 0.3008 |
| Two-Tower | 0.0262 | 0.0107 | 0.0247 | 0.0107 |

The cross-category test contains only users whose held-out item category differs from their dominant training-history category.

**Data provenance:** `synthetic_controlled`.
**Caution:** Data was generated by a controlled simulation. Metrics measure whether the model recovers patterns injected into the generator, not real customer behavior. Do not cite these numbers as business evidence.
